title: We Followed a Waymo Self-driving Car for Miles, Here's What we Saw
summary: Reporters follow Waymo self-driving cars for more than 170 miles around Arizona to see how they handle lane changes, accidents and traffic. The short video shows real-world driving behavior in 2018.
why: HN mostly cites it critically as evidence that early Waymos drove hesitantly, though one commenter points to the full video for context on a braking incident.
